r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_category IN {'A','B'} AND construction_date >= '2026-01-01', THEN bridge_wings_enclosed = true OR bridge_wing_protection_design_status = approved OR administration_approved_equivalent_bridge_wing_protection_present = true.
r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

test_cases.rationale: Category A post-2026 ship satisfies enclosed bridge-wing route.
Category B ship satisfies protective-design route.
Administration-approved equivalent bridge-wing protection satisfies route.
All three valid routes may coexist.
Category C is outside A/B obligation.
Pre-2026 construction is outside amended obligation.
Applicable category A ship satisfies no bridge-wing route.
Applicable category B ship satisfies no bridge-wing route.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
